machine: RTX 4060 Laptop GPU 8 GiB, 15 GiB RAM; ollama on 127.0.0.1:11434, models fully in VRAM
method: Each probe asks three arms (A, B, B3) sequentially at temperature 0, num_ctx 2048, and unloads the model afterwards. cold = model not resident in VRAM, so arm A includes the model load (weights were in the OS file cache from earlier runs). warm = the model was preloaded into VRAM with identical options immediately before the probe, so load is about 0.1 s. Seconds are server-side per arm; total is the sum of the three arms.

extra.note: First probe ever on qwen2.5:7b after boot (weights read from disk, not the OS cache): A 7.773 s of which 7.22 s model load, B 0.709, B3 0.589, total 9.071 s. Its paired 'warm' measurement was invalid (preload used default num_ctx, so ollama reloaded the model) and was re-measured with matching options.
extra.load_variance: Model load time varies with the OS file cache on this 15 GiB machine: arm-A load was 3.3-3.6 s with the weights cached, 7.2 s on the first read after boot, and 10.1-22.3 s in three screenshot runs taken while npm/jest/ollama were competing for RAM (total probe 11.9 s, 25.5 s, 12.7 s). The cold/warm table above is the quiet-machine measurement.

summary_endpoint.note: Research page in headless Chromium against the built app served by the same server (localhost); summary fetch 2.1 ms, items fetch 1.9 ms.
